localChanges: Late in a large game, computer players now take their turns up to twice as fast (#308, closes #306).

log: chore: standard CI workflow, prettier:check --check and no yarn.lock (civ-clone/web-renderer#66)

`getByCity` scanned every entry on each call. On a turn-247 save (huge map, ~196 cities) the three city-keyed registries were about 11% of a turn between them. A CityBuild's city is set in its constructor and never changes, so the index can't go stale and needs no `reindex`; results come back in registration order, as before. Needs core-registry ^0.1.3 for `index` (civ-clone/web-renderer#308).
CI installs with pnpm and no lock file, and this one still locked core-registry 0.1.1 against the new ^0.1.3.

`getByCity` scanned every entry on each call. On a turn-247 save (huge map, ~196 cities) the three city-keyed registries were about 11% of a turn between them. A CityImprovement's city is set in its constructor and never changes, so the index can't go stale and needs no `reindex`; results come back in registration order, as before. Needs core-registry ^0.1.3 for `index` (civ-clone/web-renderer#308).
CI installs with pnpm and no lock file, and this one still locked core-registry 0.1.1 against the new ^0.1.3.

When the next step of a path can't be taken, `moveUnit` drops it and tries the one after, which is two tiles away, then three, and so on. `unit.actions()` on a tile that isn't a neighbour runs civ1-unit's `goto` criterion, a full path search, and can never offer a `Move` (every kind of move needs `isNeighbouringTile`). So the call is skipped: what the unit does is unchanged.

On a turn-247 save (huge map, 10 players, ~1,000 units) this was 679 calls and 2.7s of a 6.3s turn; turns are now 25-44% shorter. Conformance state checksums are unchanged; only the DTO hash moves, because the skipped calls no longer use up action ids (civ-clone/web-renderer#306).
Their registries look a city's build, growth and improvements up by an index rather than scanning every entry (civ-clone/web-renderer#308).
